name: warp_queue
kind: installation, timing, on top of v1: the SM level of the queue (one release start per interval per kind, a bound on the SM's unreleased entries), the result time of member loads from their release, and the fast path of a whole-word global store to the line the warp stored last; v1's store turn in the return chain is replaced by the result rule
evidence: queue_basic v1 / v2 addenda; warp_queue v1 addendum (what failed and the release + constant reading); tools/microbench/warp_queue/sm_toy.py (a toy of one SM with rules S1 + S2 run before freezing: loop totals 256 / 160 / 512 against the hardware's 250-252 / 156 / 506 for 16 producers x 16 warps, 10 x 16 and STG 16 x 16, readers 62 / 72-76 against 62.5 / 71.7 at a bound of 44-48, per-warp cells unchanged).

rules.S1 SM release starts: Per SM and per member operation class a release (v1 Q2) can start only in a free slot of length a of that class's SM server: start_j = the earliest time >= max(F, i_j + 5.5 + 0.5 r_j) at which a slot of length a is free (the granted-interval bookkeeping of mio_basic v4 M2). a: STS of at most 32 bits 1.0; STS.64 and STS.128 4.0; LDS 1.0; SHFL.IDX 1.0; SHFL.BFLY 1.0; LDG 1.0; STG 2.0 on the fast path of S4 (other STG take no SM slot here: the store buffer limits them). Classes do not share a server (not measured either way).
rules.S2 SM bound: A member cannot issue while its SM holds 46 unreleased entries (all warps, all member kinds); it waits until the SM's oldest release. Ledger reason as v1 Q3, judged on the waiting warp's own unreleased entries; with none of its own: warp_queue:lg for LDG / STG, warp_queue:mio otherwise.
rules.S3 result of member loads: The result of LDS (every width), SHFL.IDX, SHFL.BFLY and LDG is not available before its release + c: c = 14.7 for LDS / SHFL.IDX / SHFL.BFLY on both devices, 28.3 (H100) / 30.2 (B300) for LDG. It is a floor on the existing result time (return chain, memory hierarchy), which stays. v1's Q4 (STS turn in return chain 1) is removed: stores now delay a load through its release.
rules.S4 store fast path: An STG of at least 4 bytes per lane whose lanes all fall into one 128-byte line, that line being the line this warp's previous global store wrote, does not pass the per-SM store-buffer gate; it takes the SM slot of S1 (a = 2.0). Every other global store goes through the store buffer as before.
rules.known misses (before data): two-line alternation (hardware 4.8 / 3.3 cycles per store per SM, the store buffer 8.4 / 4.6); 8- and 16-byte stores to the warp's own four lines at one warp (hardware 8 / 12 per store, the store buffer about 32 / 18); the wide-slot LDS's slow results; whether classes share the SM server.

criteria.K1 (SM rate): cycles per producer per SM (loop total / producers per SM and iteration) within 10 % of the hardware's in q.sts.n10.w16, q.sts.n12.w16, q.sts.n16.w16, q.sts.n16.w32, q.sts.e3.w16, q.lds.n16.w16, q.ldg.n16.w16, q.shfli.n16.w16, q.sts64.n16.w16, q.sts128.n16.w16, q.stg.n10.w8, q.stg.n12.w8, q.stg.n8.w16, q.stg.n10.w16, q.stg.n12.w16, q.stg.n16.w16, q.stg.e3.w8, q.stg.e3.w16; and the producers' largest wait class equals the hardware's.
criteria.K2 (per warp below the SM limit): q.sts.n5.w8, q.sts.n10.w8, q.stg.n5.w8, q.sts.n12.w4, q.sts.n12.w8, q.stg.n12.w4: loop total within 3 % and summed producer wait within max(2.0, 10 %).
criteria.K3 (readers): reader wait within 5.0 of the hardware's in q.lds.n16.w16, q.ldg.n16.w16, q.shfli.n16.w16, q.ldg.n16, q.ldg.n24, q.lds.n24, q.shfli.n24, q.fwd.sts0_lds2, .sts4_lds2, .sts8_lds2, q.fwd.stg0_ldg2, .stg4_ldg2, .stg8_ldg2, q.alt.lds_ldg.n24, q.alt.stg_ldg.n24, q.alt.sts_lds.n24, q.seq.stg6_ldg18.
criteria.K4 (v1's one-warp list): warp_queue v1's K1 (its 49 cells, same three clauses) is re-judged; every cell that passed must still pass; of the cells that failed, the one-line 4-byte STG cells on H100 (q.stg.n16 / n24 / n28, q.stg.e2 / e3 / e4, q.stgd.n16 is two-line-free but eight lines: excluded) and the LDG / LDS result cells (q.ldg.n16 / n24, q.seq.sts10_ldg6, q.seq.stg10_lds6, q.alt.lds_ldg.n16 / n24, q.alt.stg_lds.n24) must now pass. v1's K2 must still pass.
criteria.K5 (no harm): over all cells of all sources the (pc, class) error does not rise by more than 0.05 against the v1 replay; each that does is listed with a cause. Cells whose loop has no member and no store: as v1's K4 against the v1 replay.
criteria.gates and runs: seven gates, replay of the fifteen sources, full GPU 500 x 2 with ledgers and comparison; full-GPU numbers reported, not criteria.

expectation_not_criterion: Full GPU: mio_throttle on STS / LDS pcs and lg_throttle on LDG appear where SMs run many warps; the store buffer's excess lg_throttle on H100 shrinks where kernels rewrite a line; short_scoreboard / long_scoreboard at readers of shared and global loads rise.
not_allowed: No value from another machine or the literature; no full-GPU case or error used to choose a rule or a value; a failed criterion is recorded as failed.

addenda.when: 2026-11-22, first replay with S1-S4 (commit c0a51da3, formal gates 0 on clone stall-attribution-54; probe replay warp_queue-r2, full GPU full-wq2 500 / 500, compare/wq2) and a completion of S2 before the second replay
addenda.text: First replay, H100 judged (B300's replay of this build was not judged; it is superseded below): K5 passes (no cell rises by more than 0.05; cells without a member in the loop unchanged), K4 48 of 49 (v1's one-warp list: 34 pass where 24 did; q.ldg.n16 is now 3.3 % long instead of short), K1 6 of 18, K2 5 of 6, K3 13 of 17. K1's failures have one cause, found with a trace of one SM (warp_queue-r2/diag/trace.txt): S1 holds -- one key per class, granted starts never closer than a, the server saturated at one start per cycle -- but the warps do not get the SM's free entries in turn. Warps waiting at S2's bound all retry at the same cycle and the scheduler's candidate order lets the same warps win each time: in q.sts.n16.w16 eight warps finish their 64 iterations at 180-185 cycles per iteration, four at 250, four at 320, the per-warp mean is 220-232 where every hardware warp has 250.4. S2 said when a waiting member may issue and not which of several; that is completed here, before the second replay: S2' -- warps waiting at the SM bound pass in the order in which they began to wait (a per-SM first-in first-out list, as the store buffer's gate already has); a warp that finds earlier waiters also waits. Tried on that one cell in a diagnostic build before this text: per-warp loop 266.1 mean, 268.2 max (hardware 250.4, the toy 256). Full GPU of the first replay against compare/wq1 (H100 / B300): MAPE 10.76 -> 10.72 % / 9.77 -> 9.73 %, attribution 0.3287 -> 0.3283 / 0.3225 -> 0.3223, (pc, class) 0.6986 -> 0.6981 / 0.7432 -> 0.7426, loop mio_throttle gap -1.08 -> -0.97 / -0.24 -> -0.22 points. Other K3 failures of the first replay, kept for the second: q.ldg.n16.w16 reader 142.8 against 71.6 and q.fwd.stg0_ldg2 58.1 against 41.0 (the LDG result floor sits on top of a memory return that is already late in these cells).

addenda.when: 2026-11-22, second replay and judgement (S1-S4 + S2' = commits c0a51da3, bb39ebd5, decf4538; gates 0 on clean clone stall-attribution-56, build build-decf4538; probe replay $CYCLESCOPE_ARTIFACT_ROOT/stall-attribution/warp_queue-r4 (judge4-<device>.txt in warp_queue-r1/), full GPU full-wq4 500 / 500, compare/wq4)
addenda.text: Said as it happened: the first build with S2' (bb39ebd5, gates 0) never finished two full-GPU H100 cases and the 32-warp probe cells -- a livelock, not found by its CTests: with the scheduler option that ends an SMSP's issue attempt at the first blocked candidate, a warp waiting behind the head ended the attempt before the head was reached; and a warp could head the store buffer's list while waiting behind others here. Fixed in decf4538 (a warp waiting behind an earlier waiter does not end the attempt; the head leaves the list when it passes the SM bound); the jobs of that build were stopped and its outputs (full-wq3, warp_queue-r3) are void. The CTests added with the fix do not reproduce the livelock (they pass on the unfixed code); the 32-warp probe cells and the full-GPU run are its only guard. Verdict of the second replay (H100 / B300): K1 FAIL 17 / 16 of 18 -- the SM rate is right in every cell but q.sts.e3.w16 (173.7 / 194.9 against 151.5 / 148.5, wait booked as not_selected) and B300 q.sts128.n16.w16 (1019 against 1165: B300's STS.128 is 4.55 per start, the rule has 4.0). K2 FAIL 5 / 4 of 6: q.sts.n12.w8 116.5 / 117.8 against 111.9 / 111.8 (4-5 % long), B300 q.sts.n5.w8 3.5 % long. K3 FAIL 13 / 8 of 17: the readers of global loads come out late -- B300 by 7-11 in every LDG cell (q.ldg.n16 75.5 against 68.4, q.ldg.n24 75.3 against 64.5, q.fwd.stg<M>_ldg2, the alternations), H100 q.fwd.stg0_ldg2 58.1 against 41.0 and q.alt.stg_ldg 81.1 against 76.1, both q.ldg.n16.w16 141.9 / 91.7 against 71.6 / 72.9, H100 q.shfli.n16.w16 57.8 against 63.0. The replay's LDG readers sit about 5-7 cycles behind release + c as computed by hand, so the floor is not applied as S3 means it or c was read too high; not yet traced. K4 FAIL: v1's one-warp list 34 / 37 of 49 pass (24 / 34 before); every cell that passed still passes; of the cells that had to pass now, q.ldg.n16 on H100 (3.3 % long) and five LDG cells on B300 (4-7 % long) do not. K5: H100 PASS; B300 FAIL on four LDG cells (mem_basic m2.ldg.n4 0.083 -> 0.135, m2.ldg.n8.w16 0.215 -> 0.312, m2.ldgd.n4 0.030 -> 0.088, q.fwd.stg4_ldg2.s 0.062 -> 0.137), same cause. Cells without a member in the loop: unchanged. Full GPU against compare/wq1 (H100 / B300): MAPE 10.76 -> 10.72 % / 9.77 -> 9.73 %; attribution 0.3287 -> 0.3283 / 0.3225 -> 0.3224; (pc, class) 0.6986 -> 0.6978 / 0.7432 -> 0.7425; pc 0.5808 -> 0.5801 / 0.6268 -> 0.6259; site 0.2532 -> 0.2529 / 0.2507 -> 0.2503; loop mio_throttle gap -1.08 -> -0.91 / -0.24 -> -0.22 points, lg_throttle +0.26 / +0.01 unchanged. Decision: S1, S2, S2' and S4 stay (K1's SM rates and the one-warp store cells pass; nothing got worse outside the LDG readers); S3's LDG constant is wrong as installed and is the open defect of this step: to be traced (where the 5-7 cycles come from) and corrected under a v3 with the B300 K5 cells as its criterion. Also open: q.sts.e3.w16's slow rate cell, STS.128 on B300, q.ldg.n16.w16's reader, the known misses listed in the rules.
